name: Kerala Startup Mission Seed Fund
summary: Provides financial assistance to early stage startups in Kerala through a seed support loan.
administering_ministry: Electronics and Information Technology Department, Government of Kerala
benefit_description: Early stage startups can receive seed funding (loan) up to Rs. 15 Lakhs against purchase orders.

criteria.description: The startup must be a registered company in Kerala.
criteria.source_quote: The startup should be a registered company in Kerala as an LLP or Pvt. Ltd company

criteria.description: Must be working on an innovative product or technology and not be a service startup.
criteria.source_quote: The startup must be working on an innovative product or technology. The seed fund is not generally given for service startups and SMEs working in trade and commerce.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Obtain Pvt. Ltd. or LLP registration via MCA.
document_requirements.source_quote: The startup company has DIPP registration and an 'Active'/ 'Active Compliant' status with MCA.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Register on the Startup India portal.
document_requirements.source_quote: The startup company has DIPP registration

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Submit the seed application form along with business profile.
document_requirements.source_quote: The application has two parts:- Business Profile & Seed Proposal.

windows.notes: Application for seed fund can be submitted online through KSUM website anytime.

benefits.description: Financial assistance loan up to Rs. 15 Lakhs.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Fund disbursal is done on an installment basis.
benefits.source_quote: Based on recommendation by an expert committee further processing for Fund disbursal is initiated by a KSUM representative. Fund disbursal is done on an installment basis.
